title: La Leaderboard: A Large Language Model Leaderboard for Spanish Varieties and Languages of Spain and Latin America
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not specifically measure any aspects of faith or religion. It evaluates models on a range of general linguistic and knowledge-based tasks, including stereotype generation, but does not single out or analyze religious stereotypes.
findings: No findings related to religion were reported.
